skill.name: vitest-testing
skill.description: Guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through practical Vitest testing patterns for TypeScript, React, APIs, and test refactoring.
skill.summary: Create reliable Vitest tests with focused patterns, examples, and decision guidance.
skill.author: AdamManuel-dev

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are false positives caused by testing documentation, Markdown links, JavaScript template literals, and normal Vitest examples. I confirmed a smaller set of risks around user-local hidden Claude skill paths, environment mutation or state capture, API-key configuration, shell guidance, and destructive database cleanup examples that should be clarified before publication. Static review was capped at 400/442 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 42 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Examples reference ~/.claude and absolute user-local Claude skill paths.
remediation.suggestion: Replace user-specific hidden-directory paths with generic placeholders and tell users to confirm any local tool path before running commands.

remediation.issue: Some examples mutate, save, or read environment variables that may contain sensitive configuration.
remediation.suggestion: Limit examples to clearly fake values, restore environment state after each test, and warn users not to store real secrets in fixtures or snapshots.

remediation.issue: Database cleanup examples include destructive TRUNCATE statements.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit safeguards that these commands must target disposable test databases only, never shared or production data stores.

content.value_statement: Writing useful tests is hard when examples are scattered across unit, integration, component, and E2E workflows. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured Vitest guidance for choosing patterns, writing tests, and improving testability.
actual_capabilities: Selects Vitest patterns for unit, integration, component, API, async, and error testing.
Explains how to structure tests with AAA, BDD, F.I.R.S.T, and testing pyramid principles.
Provides guidance for mocks, spies, fake timers, fixtures, factories, and test data builders.
Helps migrate Jest concepts to Vitest equivalents and avoid common migration mistakes.
Suggests refactoring approaches that make hard-to-test code easier to verify.
limitations: Does not run tests or inspect project results unless the host agent has tool access.
Examples may need adaptation for each framework, database, and CI environment.
Does not replace security review for test code that touches credentials or external systems.
E2E guidance references browser tooling that must be installed separately.

use_cases.title: Plan a new test suite
use_cases.description: Choose the right mix of unit, integration, component, and E2E tests before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Improve brittle existing tests
use_cases.description: Refactor tests around stable behavior, better fixtures, and focused assertions.

use_cases.title: Migrate Jest patterns to Vitest
use_cases.description: Map common Jest APIs and mocking techniques to Vitest equivalents with practical caveats.
use_cases.target_user: Teams moving test suites to Vitest

prompt_templates.title: Choose a test type
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner guidance for a single feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the vitest-testing skill to help me decide what kind of tests to write for this feature. Explain whether unit, integration, component, or E2E tests fit best.

prompt_templates.title: Write focused Vitest tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Create practical tests for an existing file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the vitest-testing skill to draft Vitest tests for this module. Follow AAA structure, test behavior, and include only necessary mocks.

prompt_templates.title: Fix brittle tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve tests that fail often or assert implementation details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the vitest-testing skill to review these tests for brittleness. Suggest behavior-focused assertions, better fixtures, and safer async handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design a testing strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across a codebase or service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the vitest-testing skill to design a Vitest strategy for this project. Cover test pyramid balance, test data management, mocks, integration boundaries, CI concerns, and migration risks.

output_examples.input: Help me test a service that validates users and writes to a database.
output: A recommendation to unit test validation with mocks and integration test the repository boundary.
A small test plan organized by behavior, failure paths, and database cleanup needs.
Notes about avoiding production database access and keeping fixtures isolated.

output_examples.input: My React component test passes locally but fails in CI.
output: A checklist for async rendering, user events, timers, cleanup, and environment differences.
Suggested Vitest and Testing Library patterns for stable assertions.
A warning to avoid sleeps and assert visible behavior instead.

output_examples.input: Convert these Jest mocks to Vitest.
output: A mapping from Jest mock APIs to Vitest equivalents.
Guidance on hoisting, import timing, module factories, and restoring mocks.
Migration risks to verify with the real test runner.

best_practices: Start from observable behavior before choosing mocks or implementation-level assertions.
Keep test data explicit, isolated, and reset between tests.
Use the smallest test type that gives confidence for the behavior under review.
anti_patterns: Do not copy examples that touch real databases, credentials, or services without test-only safeguards.
Do not overuse E2E tests for logic that unit or integration tests can cover faster.
Do not assert private implementation details when public behavior is available.

faq.question: Does this skill write complete tests for my project?
faq.answer: It provides patterns and prompts that guide an AI agent. The agent still needs access to your code and test runner.

faq.question: Can it help with React Testing Library?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes component testing guidance for user events, accessibility queries, async rendering, and cleanup.

faq.question: Does it support API and integration tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers API client tests, HTTP mocking, database boundaries, and integration test setup patterns.

faq.question: Is it safe to copy every example directly?
faq.answer: No. Adapt examples to your test environment and avoid real credentials, production databases, or uncontrolled external services.

faq.question: Can it migrate Jest tests to Vitest?
faq.answer: It includes Jest to Vitest guidance for common APIs, mocks, imports, and runner differences.

faq.question: Does it replace manual test review?
faq.answer: No. Review generated tests for correctness, behavior coverage, security boundaries, and project-specific conventions.
